claim: Combine Market direction and leadership concentration should matter more than broad diversification. WITH Stocks closer to 52-week highs can sustain leadership via anchoring and breakout behavior.
causal_mechanism: Leadership baskets can compound when market regime supports risk-on participation. Combined with: Price proximity to highs is a simple behavioral anchor that can reinforce continuation.
expected_effect: Improve 24/52 week stability versus SPY and parent while avoiding duplicate artifacts.
falsification_rule: Reject if selected universe, trades, or artifacts duplicate parent, or if monthly/yearly SPY comparison does not improve.
